detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic ultra-realistic contemporary African mining drama, documentary-grade natural light mixed with hard sources, true skin texture with sweat and fine dust, real cloth physics on worn cotton, red laterite dust in the air, high dynamic range style. [Shot 1] the shot follows the viewpoint and subject placement of <Picture 1>; the subject is the same 24-year-old Chinese man throughout, same face, same short black hair, same faded pale-blue shirt with the sleeves rolled to the forearm over dark grey work trousers. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. He is already several paces clear of the sliding doors and keeps walking at the same unhurried pace toward the hard shadow line ahead of him until it crosses his chest, the suitcase wheels turning under his left hand and the folded slip of paper still held up in his right; his head, already turned up and to the right, comes back down and round to the left once, then settles forward. The speaker (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover, calm and low, the voice comes from off-screen while nobody in frame moves their lips,: <d>[Chinese] 高一那年父亲车祸去世，母亲为了供我读书，</d> while their lips remain completely closed. suitcase wheels rolling on concrete. His head turns to the left and scans the kerb, then settles; the suitcase stops rolling and he shifts his weight onto the other foot. The speaker (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover, calm and low, the voice comes from off-screen while nobody in frame moves their lips,: <d>[Chinese] 远赴非洲投奔远房表叔顾万通，</d> while their lips remain completely closed. wheels stopping. His right hand lifts a small folded paper note up to chest height and he looks at it for a beat, then lowers it; he settles standing astride the shadow line. The speaker (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover, the last word held slightly, the voice comes from off-screen while nobody in frame moves their lips,: <d>[Chinese] 一去就是七年。</d> while their lips remain completely closed. paper crackling faintly.

overall_soundscape:
Suitcase wheels rolling on concrete. Wheels stopping. Paper crackling faintly.
